title: RulePackStagedPayload
description: Payload of the RulePackStaged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.
